maddeler.e:
نحتكر (form VIII)
# نَحْتَكِرُ (naḥtakiru) /naħ.ta.ki.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# نُحْتَكَرُ (nuḥtakaru) /nuħ.ta.ka.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# نَحْتَكِرَ (naḥtakira) /naħ.ta.ki.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# نُحْتَكَرَ (nuḥtakara) /nuħ.ta.ka.ra/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
